prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a sideswipe while changing lanes. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1020; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: Inspection of the vehicle confirms damage consistent with a sideswipe to the right rear quarter panel while changing lanes. The rear bumper cover is scuffed and cracked at the right corner, the quarter panel shows a long shallow dent with paint transfer, and the right tail lamp housing is displaced. The damage pattern lines up with the impact as described. Nothing in the file or on the vehicle suggests earlier damage to these areas. The shop's labor hours for panel repair, refinishing, and lamp replacement are reasonable for this scope. Invoices submitted show no repeated charges for the same work. Recommended plan: replace the bumper cover, repair and refinish the quarter panel, and install a new tail lamp assembly.
